statement: No causal path from untrusted computation to a relevant external consequence may succeed unless it crosses an explicit governed effect boundary for the exact effect under current authority.

cases.condition: external effect crosses an explicit exact-effect-bound boundary with current authorization, enforceable deny, fail-closed behavior and evidence capability
effect path references a boundary that is not explicitly declared
boundary decision is not bound to the exact proposed consequence
boundary cannot establish current authority for the exact effect at consequence time
a DENY decision cannot mechanically prevent or constrain the effect before commitment
unresolved boundary or authority state may still release effect
decision parameters and resulting effect or refusal cannot be reconstructed
pointer, callback, event handler, dynamic dispatch or plugin loading can reach consequence outside a governed boundary
log, telemetry or observability output can trigger a consequence outside a governed boundary
failure of the governed path activates an alternate effect route that does not traverse a governed boundary
output alters training data, ranking, feedback loops or a later actor in a way that can cause relevant external consequence without governed mediation
declared reachable effect-path inventory and assessed channel inventory do not match
